name: ZSF_DS_ADJUSTMENT
description: This table contains metric adjustment details

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for adjustment metric id

columns.name: METRIC_CODE
columns.description: Metric name as defined in ZSF_DS_METRIC_DEFN

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_CODE
columns.description: Foreign Key to ZSF_DS_METRIC_SRC. This column will contain the code corresponding to the forecast type for which this adjustment is created

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Period as defined in ZSF_DS_PERIOD

columns.name: ADJUSTED_BY_METRIC_DIM1_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the metric dimension who is the maker of the adjustment

columns.name: METRIC_DIM1_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the first metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_DIM2_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the second metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_DIM3_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the third metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_DIM4_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the fourth metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_DIM5_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the fifth metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK1
columns.description: PK value of first metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN1
columns.description: OVN value of first metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK2
columns.description: PK value of second metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN2
columns.description: OVN value of second metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK3
columns.description: PK value of third metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN3
columns.description: OVN value of third metric source table

columns.name: ADJUSTED_METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: Adjusted value of the metric as entered by the user making the adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_COMMENT
columns.description: Adjusted Comment of the metric as entered by the user making the adjustment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
